papers.title: Koopman Generative Operators for Efficient Probabilistic Time-Series Forecasting
papers.summary: KGO unifies structured latent dynamics with single-step flow matching and adaptive uncertainty gating to achieve accurate, efficient probabilistic time-series forecasting.

papers.title: VidDub: Replacement-Aware Distillation for Two-Step Video Dubbing
papers.summary: VidDub is a two-step diffusion video dubbing model that uses replacement-aware cross-audio supervision to avoid conflicting source-mouth targets and achieves strong lip synchronization with high visual fidelity.
